verdict.summary: The new opt-in dateTime/date dual-leaf member is internally consistent with the §13 design: host builders use the existing strict encoders for both operands, split signed field hooks without modular assumptions, compute the disclosed verdict rather than accepting it, and serialize public/private inputs in the Noir ABI order. The circuit range-checks the private magnitude, rejects negative zero, rebinds sign, lane constant, and lexical component to operand_enc, and reuses the established signed verdict. Verifier reconstruction and circuit-id derivation cover the new variant, dispatch classifies it as value-lane-only, and the focused tests exercise real host/circuit cross-vectors including pre-epoch order, lying verdicts, sign flips, lane swaps, malformed lexicals, and wire ordering. The in-circuit test skips when nargo is unavailable, but equivalent Noir unit tests are included and the gated path invokes the real witness generator when present. Claims consistently retain the INV-VL downgrade and external-audit caveat (sq-qhy4), and the feature remains off by default.
